dogecoin.text:
Yo, $PEPE and $MOG mooning cause Elon sneezed their way  
NFTs flexing utility, but CryptoPunks still hog the spotlight  
Layer2's eating Ethereum's lunch, AI coins acting wise  
Memecoins? Pure chaos, $DOGE barking loudest  
Catch up or get rekt, degens

Dogecoin pumps on Elon's whim, while Vitalik's preaching green crypto dreams.  

Succinct and Mamo? Flashy new kids, probably dumping by dawn.  

Pudgy Penguins waddle in millions - NFT hype or another rugpull?  

Crypto's a circus, and we're all clowns. 🫠
